about: Graphics cards the tensor-rate unlock is offered on (gpuunlock, Settings > Power > Graphics card). Exact matches only: device, board (subsystem), VBIOS and driver series. No wildcards; a new entry needs a link to a run on that exact board and starts as experimental. Plan: Labyrinth OS docs/GPU_UNLOCK.md.

entries.notes: The author's ASUS card. The firmware inputs are not redistributed: the loader must be built locally from the owner's own ROM.
